observations: RETROSPECTIVE: this report was authored after execution as part of WP-6c. Metrics are transcribed from DEC-0004, the H-004 trial_log entry, and the H-004 experiment notebook. H-004 produced positive total PnL and positive full-period Sharpe of 0.746191460507614, but Sharpe remained below the 1.0 promotion threshold, max drawdown reached 69.7950%, and the largest 90-day window failed the concentration gate. The strategy failed 3 of 8 D2-006 gates, and DEC-0004 archived the candidate as a baseline NO-GO. Max-drawdown and cost-drag values are under pre-WP-5b pipeline semantics; per WP-5a/WP-5b audit conclusions the overall NO-GO verdict is unaffected by later pipeline fixes.
diagnostic_findings: Daily dual moving-average trend following with a realized-volatility regime filter is not promotable under current promotion gates.
The strategy produced the strongest Sharpe among early daily baselines, but still failed the OOS Sharpe promotion threshold.
Max drawdown reached 69.7950%, breaching both the D2-006 drawdown gate and the pre-registered kill framing.
Gate concentration failed because the largest 90-day window contributed 99.0100% of total PnL on the evaluator metric.
WP-4a failure analysis treats H-004 as evidence against the tested daily trend implementation, not against all trend or regime-filter ideas.
